# @stacklatte/chart-core

> GPU-accelerated (Skia) React Native trading chart. Candlesticks, line charts, SMA/EMA/Bollinger Bands overlays, RSI/MACD/volume sub-panels, trade markers (entry/exit/stop-loss/take-profit), pinch-zoom/pan, crosshair inspection, live-streaming updates, dark/light themes — one component, MIT licensed. Ships an LLM-safe declarative `ChartConfig` + generated JSON Schema.

## Install

```sh
npm install @stacklatte/chart-core @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-gesture-handler
```

Peers: `react >=19`, `react-native >=0.79`, `@shopify/react-native-skia >=2.0`, `react-native-gesture-handler >=2.0`.

## Minimal usage

```tsx
import { SLChart } from '@stacklatte/chart-core';
import type { Candle } from '@stacklatte/chart-core';

<SLChart data={candles /* Candle[]: {timestamp, open, high, low, close} */} width={width} height={400} theme="dark" />
```

## Generating config with an LLM

Prefer emitting a `ChartConfig` document over hand-written props when a model is generating chart setup — every string field is a closed enum (no raw hex colors, no arbitrary interval strings), and `buildChartPipeline` throws a structured, itemized error if the document doesn't validate instead of rendering something silently wrong.

```ts
import { buildChartPipeline } from '@stacklatte/chart-core';
const compiled = buildChartPipeline(config, candles); // -> spread into <SLChart {...compiled} width height />
```

The matching JSON Schema (draft-07, `additionalProperties: false` everywhere) is published at `dist/ChartConfig.schema.json` inside this package after install — use it directly as a structured-output / tool-call schema.

## Full docs

See [README.md](./README.md) for the complete prop table, every indicator/overlay example, the `markers` prop (`ChartMarker[]`), gesture reference, theming, and the architecture of individual render layers (`AxisLayer`, `CandlestickLayer`, `IndicatorLayer`, `MarkerLayer`, `VolumeLayer`, etc., all exported for custom compositions).
